block.create_aeronautics_extra.onboard_c: A vehicle's or ship's electrics in one block: up to 4 modules — generator (shaft → current) and battery (24 V). Right-click with a module to install; sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take the last one out.
Shaft in the back face. Terminals «+» (red) and «−» (blue) in the box on the casing.
item.create_aeronautics_extra.generator_: For the Onboard Computer: 6 W per rpm, 8 SU per rpm of stress. Charges the batteries; without them feeds the terminals directly (0.5 V per rpm).
item.create_aeronautics_extra.battery_mo: For the Onboard Computer: a 24 V cell like the EE accumulator. Holds the onboard voltage, charges from generator modules and from the EE network. Keeps its charge when removed.
create_aeronautics_extra.goggles.title: Onboard Computer:
create_aeronautics_extra.goggles.hint: Right-click with a module to install it
